#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  const char *request = getenv("KUBERNETES_EXEC_INFO");
  if (argc != 3 || !request || !strstr(request, "client.authentication.k8s.io/v1") ||
      !strstr(request, "\"interactive\":false") || strstr(request, "\"cluster\":")) return 2;
  FILE *input = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
  if (!input) return 3;
  char response[8192];
  size_t bytes = fread(response, 1, sizeof(response), input);
  int valid = bytes > 0 && bytes < sizeof(response) && !ferror(input);
  fclose(input);
  if (!valid) return 4;
  FILE *log = fopen(argv[2], "ab");
  if (!log) return 5;
  fputc('1', log);
  fclose(log);
  if (fwrite(response, 1, bytes, stdout) != bytes) return 6;
  return 0;
}
